collection.credit:
HEATHEN-ONLY EVENTS (HE-01 to HE-45, draft for the owner, 2026-11-23, target v1.35.98)
New Believers only. Island events about the Heathens' own lives: honoring their dead, Heathen versions of events our villagers already have, and small moments of camp life.

collection.description: A Heathen and a villager who both lost someone long ago meet by chance at the mausoleum.

description_variants.description: An Isolan and a villager who both lost someone long ago meet by chance at the mausoleum.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject), a Heathen, and (friend), a villager, both lost someone in the bad years before the two peoples learned to leave each other in peace. Today, by chance, they both end up at the mausoleum at the same time, and stand awkwardly a few graves apart.

variants.text: (subject), an Isolan, and (friend), a villager, both lost someone in the bad years before the two peoples learned to leave each other in peace. Today, by chance, they both end up at the mausoleum at the same time, and stand awkwardly a few graves apart.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: Neither of them says anything about the past. (friend) offers (subject) a flower from (friend.his/her) own bunch. (subject) takes it and lays it down. They leave by different paths, but from then on they nod to each other when they pass.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) waits until (friend) has finished, then takes (subject.his/her) turn. Neither feels they owe the other anything. Grief does not have to be shared to be respected.
